title: Adopt Apps
description: Move the Angular and Flutter apps of this workspace that build without the plugin to its release target (Angular) or flutter-build target (Flutter web), in place: base hrefs and post-build steps read from the workspace's own build script, environments/<app>/htaccess.<env> and env files, env encryption settings, build:<app>:<env> npm scripts. Old scripts are kept.

projects.description: Apps to adopt (default: every Angular app without a release target and every Flutter app whose web build does not use flutter-build).

scripts.description: Point the apps' build:<app>:<env> npm scripts at nx run <app>:release:<env>.

removeOldScripts.description: Delete the old build pipeline scripts nothing uses any more (package.json, project.json, CI and git hooks are checked).

report.description: Where the report goes (workspace-relative path; a folder ending in / gets pstack-adopt.md), or false for none. Saved as nx.json pstack.adopt.report. Default docs/migrations/adopt.md.
